_registration._how: Sign this `listing` object with your owner identity per the H-Index signing contract (Ed25519 over canonical JSON for hedera/xrpl/solana/stellar, or EIP-712 for EVM/Hedera-ECDSA; EIP-712 signers append { name: 'termsVersion', type: 'string' } as the last Register field). Attach the signature + CAIP-10 identity as required by /register, then submit with an x402 payment.
_registration._owner_identity: REPLACE with your CAIP-10 owner account, e.g. hedera:mainnet:0.0.x or xrpl:0:rKxTzCKYKPPdXEzuioEQ6KekQK26w2DBd5
_registration._registration_fee: $10.00 USD (registrationPriceUsdCents=1000), one-time, via x402. Pay the H-Index treasury for your chosen chain: XRPL r3fh96NKG8KMhB8cV8f6sZgPyTZkiNp9Y7 (RLUSD), Base 0x1D98D4D523aAf3A6684f744292ac70E319FD546E (USDC), or Hedera 0.0.10490145 (USDC 0.0.456858). Listing expires after 1 year; renewal is $5.
_registration._note: Claude cannot sign or pay (no key access). The `id` is assigned by H-Index on register (topic 0.0.10601198/seq).

listing.description: The XRPL-Utilities MCP server: one endpoint fronting six XRP Ledger data products. Sentinel (wallet behavior classifier), Pulse (on-chain signal feed, RWA supply, exchange and whale flows), Telemetry (active-float supply, utility floor, settlement series), Trust (XLS-70/80/81 permissioned-domain and credential directory), Vault (real-world-asset issuer and supply tracker), and Flows (spot and indirect XRP ETF AUM vs XRPL on-chain flow correlation). Exposes 41 tools (xrpl_sentinel_*, xrpl_pulse_*, xrpl_telemetry_*, xrpl_trust_*, xrpl_vault_*, xrpl_flows_*); free discovery and summary tools, paid scan and detail tools settle $0.10 USD per call via x402. Stateless passthrough: holds no wallet, database, or secrets; the caller provides their own payment header.

pricing.note: Free discovery and summary tools. Scan and detail tools settle $0.10 USD per call via x402 payment headers on the chain you choose: XRP or RLUSD on XRPL, or USDC on Base. The server is a stateless passthrough; the caller provides their own payment envelope.

tools.name: xrpl_sentinel_scan
tools.description: Paid ($0.10 USD). Classify an XRPL wallet by on-chain activity pattern. Returns activity_score (0-100), activity_level, confidence, behavioral signals, top counterparties, and AI reasoning.

tools.name: xrpl_sentinel_scan_history
tools.description: Paid ($0.10 USD). Return up to 25 prior recorded scans for an address to read score trajectory over time.

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_recent_events
tools.description: Paid ($0.10 USD). Most-recent XRPL signal events newest-first. Mixes news, whale activity, permissioned-domain lifecycle, Sentinel signals, and RWA issuer flows. Filterable by kind, time range, and min whale USD.

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_events_by_address
tools.description: Paid ($0.10 USD). Pulse events referencing a specific XRPL address (whale, sentinel signal, news, permissioned-domain). Complements xrpl_sentinel_scan with event history.

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_stream_purchase
tools.description: Paid (tiered: 1h ~$0.50 / 6h ~$2.50 / 24h ~$7.50). Buy a time-boxed WebSocket subscription to live Pulse events. Returns a stream_token JWT and ws_url. Server-side filtering by source, signal, and min USD is bound into the token at purchase.

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_ripple_counterparties
tools.description: Free. Anonymized Ripple-counterparty auto-discovery and relay-burst detector findings. Score-tier and funding-source distributions; specific wallet addresses not exposed.

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_ripple_topology
tools.description: Free. Ripple ecosystem topology map: Source (treasury/issuer/escrow wallets), Pipeline (curated middle layer by role), and Exits (named CEX hot wallets).

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_cex_attribution
tools.description: Free. CEX attribution walker findings: backward-walked payment chains ending at named exchanges. Hop count, total USD, anchor and terminal labels; specific addresses not exposed.

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_network_stats
tools.description: Free. XRPL network summary: funded addresses, trustline count, offer count, 24h active addresses, and snapshot freshness.

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_whale_flow_24h
tools.description: Free. Trailing 24h whale Payment aggregate: total USD, tx count, top labels, per-currency breakdown. No specific addresses returned.

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_exchange_flow_delta
tools.description: Free. Per-UTC-day series of net XRPL exchange flow: inbound, outbound, net, and settlement volume. Same series used in XR-Flows ETF correlation.

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_rwa_summary
tools.description: Free. Cross-issuer RWA rollup: obligations, net-circulating supply, trustline count, 24h mint/burn flow, and AMM pool exposure per tracked issuer.

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_exchange_net_flow
tools.description: Free. Per-exchange directional net flow from labeled whale events. Inflow/outflow/net per named exchange with trend and market positioning flag. Holder-centric sign: net_flow_usd = outflow minus inflow, so positive = XRP leaving the exchange (off-exchange accumulation), negative = XRP arriving (distribution).

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_escrow_calendar
tools.description: Free. Forward-looking Ripple XRP escrow release calendar with monthly unlock schedule, relock history, and net release rate.

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_entity_positioning
tools.description: Free. Per-entity (exchange, treasury, MM) accumulation vs distribution scoring from labeled whale events with daily breakdown. net_usd is the objective balance delta (inflow minus outflow); net_direction is holder-centric and role-aware (accumulation = XRP leaving the liquid market, i.e. exchange withdrawals or a treasury/MM pulling XRP in).

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_rlusd_distribution
tools.description: Free. RLUSD mint-to-CEX distribution: where Ripple's freshly-minted RLUSD goes. Splits outgoing RLUSD from the distribution wallet into by_exchange (named venue), to_labeled_non_exchange (transit hops, consolidators, MMs), and unattributed, with to_exchange_pct + a mint_context block. Corrects reading a fresh RLUSD mint as XRP sell-pressure: RLUSD routed to an exchange is institutional stablecoin provisioning. Amounts are RLUSD face value (USD-pegged ~$1).

tools.name: xrpl_desk_briefing
tools.description: Free. Composite desk briefing: market posture, headline narrative, positioning (top accumulator/distributor + reversals), RLUSD health (velocity + growth + peg), supply pressure (escrow + relock), RWA market, whale activity, and alerts. One call replaces 6-8 separate tool calls.

tools.name: xrpl_pulse_token_health
tools.description: Free. Per-token health scores for top 200 XRPL tokens: sovereignty, distribution, liquidity, transparency, demand pipeline. Each dimension 0-10 with green/yellow/red. Filter by issuer wallet or currency code.

tools.name: xrpl_telemetry_snapshot
tools.description: Paid ($0.10 USD). One-shot XRPL macro snapshot: supply breakdown, liquidity flows, AMM state, derived Active Float model, and utility floor price.

tools.name: xrpl_telemetry_get_quote
tools.description: Paid flow step 1 ($0.10 USD total). Start async invoice flow: returns invoice_id, payTo address, deepLink, QR, and expiry. Pay via XRPL Payment, then poll get_status, then call get_results.

tools.name: xrpl_telemetry_get_status
tools.description: Paid flow step 2 (no extra charge). Poll invoice status from get_quote. Returns paid (bool), amount, ledger_index, and expiry.

tools.name: xrpl_telemetry_get_results
tools.description: Paid flow step 3 (no extra charge). Fetch full Telemetry snapshot payload once invoice is paid. Same shape as xrpl_telemetry_snapshot.

tools.name: xrpl_telemetry_settlement_totals
tools.description: Free. XRPL settlement volume rollup: 24h/7d/30d USD volume across XRP and RLUSD, annualized run rate, and payment counts.

tools.name: xrpl_telemetry_settlement_series
tools.description: Free. Bucketed XRPL settlement volume time-series (daily / weekly / monthly) with USD totals, payment counts, XRP drops, and RLUSD value per bucket. Newest first, UTC-aligned. For charting or change-point detection.

tools.name: xrpl_telemetry_dex_pair_volume
tools.description: Free. Per-pair DEX volume on XRPL: 24h and 7d volume, fill counts, orderbook vs AMM source split, and annualized run rate.

tools.name: xrpl_trust_list_domains
tools.description: Paid ($0.10 USD). List all XRPL PermissionedDomain (XLS-80) objects on mainnet with owner, accepted credentials, and institutional issuer counts. Paginated.

tools.name: xrpl_trust_get_domain
tools.description: Paid ($0.10 USD). Deep dive on one PermissionedDomain by 64-hex ID: lifecycle history, permissioned market activity (XLS-81), and DID/TOML identity.

tools.name: xrpl_trust_credential_issuers
tools.description: Paid ($0.10 USD). All credential issuers across PermissionedDomains: address, label, referencing domain count, and credential types issued.

tools.name: xrpl_trust_recent_events
tools.description: Free. XLS-70/80/81 lifecycle event stream: domain creates/deletes, credential activity, permissioned offers and AMM events. Cursor-paginated.

tools.name: xrpl_trust_list_operators_index
tools.description: Free. Index of all PermissionedDomain operators: address, label, jurisdiction, status, domain count, issuer count. Paginated.

tools.name: xrpl_trust_operator_drilldown
tools.description: Paid ($0.10 USD). Deep dive on one PermissionedDomain operator: domains, credentials, jurisdiction, DID identity, institutional issuers, and lifecycle events.

tools.name: xrpl_trust_operator_attribution
tools.description: Free. Institutional attribution for one PermissionedDomain operator: parent funder, credential types, gated assets, plain-English summary, and confidence tier.

tools.name: xrpl_trust_usage_summary
tools.description: Free. Ecosystem-wide PermissionedDomain activity aggregate: domain count, operator count, credential and market event totals over a configurable window.

tools.name: xrpl_trust_jurisdictions
tools.description: Free. Jurisdiction rollup across XRPL's permissioned stack: per-country operator and issuer counts with an unattributed bucket.

tools.name: xrpl_vault_scan
tools.description: Paid ($0.10 USD). Per-issuer RWA deep dive: supply, mint/burn flow, AMM exposure, and daily history. Accepts wallet address, issuer label, or currency code.

tools.name: xrpl_vault_daily_flow
tools.description: Free. Cross-issuer daily RWA flow series: mint/burn event counts per day and USD-pegged net inflow aggregate. Complements the paid per-issuer scan.

tools.name: xrpl_flows_scan
tools.description: Paid ($0.10 USD). Per-ETF deep dive for US-listed spot XRP ETFs (XRP/XRPC/XRPZ/GXRP/TOXR/XRPR): metadata, latest AUM reading, daily history, and on-chain exchange-flow delta.

tools.name: xrpl_flows_correlation
tools.description: Free. Daily ETF AUM vs XRPL exchange-flow delta for six spot XRP ETFs with 7-day rolling Pearson correlation. Correlation only, not causation.

tools.name: xrpl_flows_cross_border_flow
tools.description: Free. XRPL cross-border settlement flow: country-pair aggregates (inbound/outbound/net USD), top corridors, and coverage block. Institutional/exchange wallets only.

tools.name: xrpl_flows_launch_impact
tools.description: Free. Per-ETF launch-window analysis: [L-30, L+30] exchange-flow delta and DEX volume around each spot XRP ETF launch date.

tools.name: xrpl_flows_etf_flow_summary
tools.description: Free. Daily ETF flow summary: per-ticker AUM with day-over-day delta, growth rate, and aggregate XRP supply share.
